description: Your own recent stream connections (this account only, every API key and OAuth app of it), newest first: path, url, api_key_id (or oauth_client_id), connected_at, `state` open or closed, the subscribe count and, once closed, closed_at, duration_s, the channels, close_code (4410 = replaced by a newer connection) and events_sent. RECONSTRUCTED from the connect, subscribe and close records the stream writes, not read from the stream's live state, and it may lag a few seconds: `open` means no close has been recorded yet (a server crash records none), and an open connection's channels are named only when it closes. Use it to see why a socket was closed or whether two programs share a key (each closes the other with 4410). `truncated` is true when only the newest records of the window could be read.

hours.description: How far back to look, 1 to 720 hours (default 168, a week). A connection opened before it is not listed.

limit.description: Connections to return, newest first, 1 to 1000 (default 50).

name: stream_connections
title: Stream Connections
